subject: Renewal: experimentation platform (LaunchDarkly) — pricing/contract ops
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@launchdarkly.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking the time last week. Attached is the Q3 renewal quote (LD_Quote_Redwood_2026Q3.pdf) that reflects the enterprise bundle we discussed: 30M monthly impressions, SSO + SCIM integration, audit log retention to 12 months, and a dedicated customer success runway for the first 90 days of renewal.

Summary of commercials: 12-month term, list price $145k/yr, proposed 18% partnership discount -> $118,900/yr. This includes standard CDE and a 30% onboarding credit to use against professional services.

I also attached an SLA/security annex (SLAs_and_Security_Annex.docx) per your team's asks. Happy to hop on a call to walk the legal team through the annex if helpful.

Best,
Samira
Account Executive — LaunchDarkly

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@launchdarkly.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Samira —

Thanks, received. Quick internal notes so we can prioritize review:
- Finance (Markus): need to confirm whether the 12-month cadence aligns with our reserved capacity budgeting (we're consolidating Q3 commitments).
- Security (Grace): will validate the annex items on data residency & log retention — we may need a short addendum for EU customers.
- Product (Rishi): wants confirmation the SCIM delta will include group sync for feature-scoped teams.

Two asks to accelerate sign: could LaunchDarkly (a) extend current pricing for 45 days while we route legal/procurement, and (b) provide a one-time credit for migration support beyond the 30% onboarding credit (we've got complex flag migrations across environments).

Copying Markus/Grace/Rishi to pick up the technical/legal threads.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Vanessa —

Reviewed the quote. A few commercial redlines from finance:
- Request net 45 payment terms (current is net 30).
- Need revenue recognition alignment (we capitalize licensing across quarters).
- The proposed discount nets to ~18% which is okay, but if we commit to 24 months we should be able to secure an additional 7–10% off list.

If legal flags no major items on the SLA, I'm comfortable asking for 24 months at ~20% effective discount. That helps smoothing our budgets.

Markus
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@launchdarkly.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Samira —

Two security clarifications before we can sign:
1) Data residency: we need an explicit statement that flag decision metadata for EU customers will be stored in the EU region; if not standard, we'll need an addendum.
2) Audit logs: confirm the retention SLA and export process (we want programmatic exports to our internal archive).

Also, mention of a dedicated CS runway is helpful — can you confirm the CS SLA (response times, escalation path)?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Samira Khan <samira@launchdarkly.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Thanks everyone — quick replies inline: 
- Pricing hold: we can commit to a 45-day price hold starting today.
- Migration credit: I can add a one-time $10k migration support credit to the order given the complexity described — will show as a line item on the quote.
- SCIM groups: product supports nested groups; we'll include a tech note to confirm group sync scope.
- EU residency: LD can commit to EU-only storage for flag metadata for EU tenants; we'll produce an addendum.
- Audit logs: we provide programmatic exports via API; I'll attach export doc sample in a follow-up.
- CS SLA: proposed 4-hour P1 response for enterprise accounts, escalation to a named CSM and TAM within 24 hours.

Next steps I propose:
1) I update the quote with the migration credit + 45-day hold.
2) We issue an addendum for EU residency and forward to your legal for review.
3) If commercial is ok, procurement (Markus) and legal sign and we route for DocuSign.

I'll circulate an updated PDF by EOD Friday.

Best,
Samira

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@launchdarkly.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchDarkly renewal quote and enterprise terms

Samira —

Appreciate the quick clarifications and for adding the migration credit + hold. A few internal decisions:
- Finance prefers we sign a 24-month term if LaunchDarkly can increase the migration credit to $15k or provide a staggered invoice schedule (Q3/Q4) to smooth run-rate.
- Product (Rishi) would like a short technical runbook from LD on rollback best practices; this will be a gating doc for Eng to approve.
- Security (Grace) is satisfied pending the EU addendum and an export API example.

If you can update the quote with the $15k migration credit OR a payment schedule option, and attach the EU addendum + API sample, I can try to get procurement/legal to sign within the 45-day hold.

Tentative internal approval: green light to proceed pending the items above.

Thanks — will sync if legal raises redlines.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced: LD_Quote_Redwood_2026Q3.pdf, SLAs_and_Security_Annex.docx]
